subject: Kickstart: quick priority check and config help
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj@signals.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart: quick priority check and config help

Hi Raj — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the ask for next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of the call
- Goal: Validate Signals AI model routing and reduce inference cost per request for your batch analyzer (target 30% token cost reduction).
- Success criteria for the POC: 1) end-to-end pipeline running against 5k sample events/day, 2) median latency < 250ms for 512-token inference, 3) measurable cost delta with Redwood's batching + cache profile.

Next steps we discussed
1) You: share a small sample dataset and a representative request shape (S3 link or sanitized CSV).
2) Redwood: provide a POC checklist and quick SSO config instructions — attached: POC-Checklist.xlsx.
3) Mutual: agree on a 2-week run window; target start of week of Oct 11.

Blocked items we flagged
- SSO & IP allowlist for your staging cluster (we can provide a prefilled template).
- A sanitized sample dataset (you mentioned legal needs to vet).

Can you confirm what’s highest priority here and whether Oct 11 still looks good for you to kick off? If helpful, I can book a 30-minute technical setup with our integration engineer to unblock the SSO/IP steps.

Attachments: POC-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Hi Raj — checking in quickly on the sample data and SSO allowlist. I haven’t seen a reply and wanted to make sure this didn’t slip through while you’re juggling other priorities.

If the Oct 11 start is still possible we can lock in setup sessions; otherwise let me know if we should push the kickoff window. Totally flexible — I’d rather align to your timeline than keep pinging.

If useful, I added two 30-min slots on my calendar for Thursday/Friday this week for a hands-on setup: 10/7 11:00am PT or 10/8 2:00pm PT. Pick one and I’ll send an invite.

Best,
Marcus

Raj — looping back again since we still haven’t received the sample payload or SSO info. At this point I want to be respectful of your calendar and stop being noisy if this is not a priority right now. Two options:

1) Pause the kickoff now and we tentatively reschedule for a date you pick (no work started on Redwood side).
2) Keep it active and I’ll escalate to my manager for a fast-track setup call and a trimmed SOW so legal has less to review.

If you’re leaning toward (1) — what month would you like us to resume? If (2), I can include Laura (cc) to coordinate the reduced SOW and a 30-min technical alley-oop to unblock SSO.

No problem either way — just want to make sure we’re aligned.

Thanks,
Marcus
